description: Baseline (model knowledge only) vs evidence-grounded general answering. The passages and expected facts are AUTHORITATIVE FIXTURES: they are the ground truth for this evaluation, never the model's own output. Licence and figure values come from the real projects' published terms (Redis BSD-3, Memcached Apache 2.0, PostgreSQL PostgreSQL licence, SQLite public domain) and are deliberately different from what the model double claims from memory, which is exactly the audited failure mode.
mode_note: The provider is a scripted double: it repeats the case's prepared reply, so this measures the PIPELINE (what reaches the user, what QA reports), not the model's knowledge. No network, no Ollama, no vector store.
